description: On the countertop there’s an open cardboard box near the back, two markers, several small rubber ducks, and a pink and a yellow cloth. The left hand and right hand move around the surface collecting items into a small pile, then the right hand flicks a small yellow object in an arc into the open box while the left hand stays near the workspace; after that, both hands gather the pink and yellow cloths and bunch them together into a two-hand object near the center.
